mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqBulkQuotationAddAgentExcel*/ SELECT SEQ, ITEM_KEY_ID, DESCRIPTION, AGENT_CODE, AGENT_NAME, CASE WHEN STATUS = 'K2' THEN '견적마감' WHEN ID IS NULL THEN '키값 오류' WHEN AGENT_NAME IS NULL THEN '협력사 코드 오류' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BNTTRXL C WHERE C.KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} AND C.KEY_3 = AGENT_CODE) > 1 THEN '중복 등록' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = #{st_burq_no} AND RFQ.AGENT = AGENT_CODE) > 1 THEN '중복 등록' WHEN ORIGIN_AGENT_CODE = AGENT_CODE THEN '기존 협력사와 동일' ELSE '정상' END AS RESULT, ORIGIN_AGENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT KEY_2 AS SEQ, TRIM(KEY_3) AS ITEM_KEY_ID, B.ITEM_KEY_ID AS ID, TRIM(KEY_4) AS AGENT_CODE, KEP_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, AGENT AS ORIGIN_AGENT_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = TRIM(KEY_4) AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND BUSINESS_COND = 'S' ) AS AGENT_NAME, B.STATUS FROM BNTTRXL A, KEP_BURQ_RFQ B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_AGENT' AND A.TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND A.KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} AND B.AGENT_TYPE = 'B' AND A.KEY_1 = B.BURQ_NO AND A.KEY_3 = B.ITEM_KEY_ID ) ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SEQ)
